meta: Write your weekly report fast with AI: no more spending all Friday afternoon trying to remember what you did.

muc.title: A weekly report takes all afternoon
muc.text: A weekly report eats the whole afternoon usually because you're trying to remember, not because writing is hard.

muc.title: Three lines each afternoon
muc.text: Every afternoon, jot three lines in your phone notes: what's done, what's in progress, and where you're stuck.

muc.title: Fit the company template
muc.text: At the end of the week, remove client names and confidential numbers, paste your notes into a chatbot, an AI chat assistant, and ask it to fit the company's report template.

muc.title: You own the numbers
muc.text: AI may round numbers or add work you didn't do. Reread every line and correct it before sending it to your boss.

muc.title: Three lines today
muc.text: Write three lines about today's work and ask AI to turn them into a short report paragraph.

thu: Write 3 lines about today's work and ask AI to turn them into a short report paragraph.
